sources.title: GitHub - Rohan-R07/carboncoachAi
sources.snippet: CarbonCoach AI is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered decision support assistant designed to help individuals Understand, Track, and Reduce their carbon footprint. By combining mathematical rule-based metrics with personalized AI behavioral analysis, CarbonCoach AI guides users from general climate awareness to targeted, daily habit changes.
